It's officially #PrideMonth! 🏳️‍🌈

Now, the energy that everyone has for #BlackLivesMatter, can that same energy be extended to black trans people? Our lives are precious and have value too. Never forget: Stonewall was a riot, and it was led by trans women of color.

This is an example of how some companies are using #BlackLivesMatter for clout. If they have a history of being racist, have a sponsor or client who's racist, or done things like this like they did to our wonderful 
@MunroeBergdorf, then they have no business saying anything.

I doubt this will happen, but I hope when corona is over that the celebs who haven't done anything then and still aren't doing anything now about #BlackLivesMatter will be held accountable. They have black fans. Some have dated, married, had babies with black people.

It's amazing how books on racism and white privilege are selling out right now, but remember, keep reading these books long after #BlackLivesMatter isn't trending. Don't run to black people telling us what we live and know: TALK TO YOUR PEOPLE. Support black-owned bookstores!!

Okay, they look good, cool, but...

When we say #BlackLivesMatter we mean even black people who aren't dressed nice, who don't have degrees, who aren't Black Excellence, who aren't conventionally attractive, etc. deserve to not be killed by police. 

https://t.co/f5uscPvUZT

Today I blocked someone on my Facebook who's married to a black man, but he's proud to say "I'm a white guy and I don't agree with #BlackLivesMatter!!!" Meanwhile his husband is quiet, makes no mention of his husband's actions. 

Couples like that are disturbing as fuck to me.
